# Photomicrograph_Topology_Extraction

**Domain**: Cross
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted

## Definition
The process of deriving the interconnection graph of a nanowire network from its microscopic image data. Provides a scalable method to map physical neuromorphic substrates for TCC/iNEST design and validation.
